text: dsh-project-memory 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的项目记忆插件：通过 /memory 命令和模型工具管理项目记录，并把候选与正式记忆保存在工作区。它支持提出决策、约束、约定、经验和事实，要求人工审批后才纳入正式记忆；可按关键词搜索、查看、归档和检查证据是否仍有效。证据保存相对路径及行范围和哈希，不复制源码片段。适合希望跨会话维护可审阅项目约定的开发团队；无需 API 密钥或云服务。

dsh-project-memory adds project memory to DeepSeek Harness. Agents propose decisions, constraints, conventions, lessons, or facts for human approval. Users can search records and validate hashed source references. Data stays in project files, with no API key or cloud service.
想把项目决策和约束留给后续会话查阅。
让 agent 提议项目记忆，但必须由人确认后才生效。
我想按关键词搜索已经批准的项目约定。
怎样查看某条已批准的项目记忆？
源代码改动后，怎么检查记忆引用的证据还有效？
需要管理项目记忆候选、冲突和人工审批流程。
I want project decisions to persist across agent sessions and remain searchable.
How can an agent suggest project memory that requires a person to approve it?
dsh-project-memory 的功能「候选记忆审批」：模型工具可提交带证据的项目记忆候选；用户通过 /memory approve 批准，或拒绝候选，未审批内容不会进入正式记忆。
dsh-project-memory 的功能「搜索与读取」：用户可用 /memory search 按关键词查找已批准的活动记忆，也可用 /memory show 查看单条记录；模型工具提供对应搜索和读取操作。
dsh-project-memory 的功能「证据校验」：每条证据记录项目内相对路径、行范围和 SHA-256；/memory validate 可检查引用状态，识别源行变化或文件缺失。
dsh-project-memory 的功能「冲突与归档」：新增记忆与同主题活动记录冲突时，审批需要声明 supersedes 或明确选择保留并存；用户也可归档记录并查看记忆时间线。

dsh-project-memory README · dsh-project-memory：Evidence-backed, human-approved project memory for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

`dsh-project-memory` turns durable decisions, constraints, conventions, lessons, and facts into versioned project records. The model may propose a candidate, but only the human-facing `/memory approve` command can promote it into approved memory.

dsh-project-memory README · dsh-project-memory：> DeepSeek Harness is currently a developer preview. This plugin targets `0.1.0-rc.6` and may require updates as Harness APIs evolve.

[中文说明](./README.zh.md)

dsh-project-memory README · Why this is different：- Human approval is a hard boundary: model tools cannot approve or archive memory.
- Evidence is project-relative and hash-verified; source snippets are not copied into memory.
- Conflicting active memories require `supersedes` or an explicit `--keep-both` decision.
- Approved entries are Git-friendly JSON; candidate files are kept in a separate review queue.
- Search is deterministic and local. No embeddings, cloud database, or background service.

dsh-project-memory README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-project-memory
```

Restart the selected Harness profile after installation.

dsh-project-memory README · Commands：```text
/memory capture [note]
/memory candidates
/memory approve <candidate-id> [--keep-both]
/memory reject <candidate-id> [reason]

The plugin also exposes read-only model tools for search/read/validation and one write-limited proposal tool.

dsh-project-memory README · Storage：```text
.dsh/project.json
.dsh/memory/index.json
.dsh/memory/entries/memory_*.json
.dsh/memory/candidates/candidate_*.json

Commit `.dsh/project.json`, `.dsh/memory/index.json`, and `.dsh/memory/entries/` if the team wants shared memory. Candidate files may remain local until reviewed.

dsh-project-memory README · Evidence lifecycle：Each evidence reference records a relative path, exact line range, optional symbol, and SHA-256 hash. `/memory validate` reports `verified`, `stale`, or `missing` after source changes.

dsh-project-memory README · Development：```bash
npm install
npm run check
npm pack --dry-run
```
